# `particle_voice/nn/memory/ActivationArena.js`

> **Source:** `agi/particle_voice/nn/memory/ActivationArena.js`

ActivationArena.js — Phase 1 ParticleNN memory. Transient GPU-buffer pool for activation tensors, keyed by byte size: `acquire(tensorName, byteLength)` reuses a same-size buffer already released by an earlier tensor instead of allocating a new one, and `release(tensorName)` (driven by `TensorLifetimePlanner.freedAfter()`) returns a buffer to the pool the moment its last consumer has run.

## Classes

### `class ActivationArena`

| Method | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `constructor` | `constructor(device)` |  |
| `acquire` | `acquire(tensorName, byteLength)` | Get (allocating or reusing a pooled buffer of the exact same size) the GPU buffer for `tensorName`. |
| `release` | `release(tensorName)` | Return `tensorName`'s buffer to the free pool (does not destroy it — it is expected to be reused by a same-size tensor soon). |
| `isActive` | `isActive(tensorName)` |  |
| `pooledCount` | `get pooledCount()` | Total buffers currently pooled (free) + active, for memory-pressure diagnostics. |
| `activeCount` | `get activeCount()` |  |
| `destroyAll` | `destroyAll()` | Destroy every buffer (active and pooled) — end of program run / full teardown. |

## Notes & Examples

### Where this fits in the training loop

AGI runs an **observation → brain → action → reward** loop each tick: observations are gathered from the world, a brain maps them to actions, the rig applies motion, and rewards shape the next update.

**Example: Minimal training loop**
```js
import { Agent } from 'agi/core/Agent.js';
import { World } from 'agi/env/World.js';

const world = new World();
const agent = new Agent({
  brain: 'ppo',
  observationSpace: world.observationSpace,
  actionSpace: world.actionSpace
});

for (let step = 0; step < 10000; step++) {
  const obs = world.getObservation();      // Gather observations
  const action = agent.act(obs);            // Brain decides action
  const { reward, done } = world.step(action); // Apply action, get reward
  agent.learn(obs, action, reward);         // Update from experience
  
  if (done) world.reset();
}
```

**See also:** [AGI Training Guide](/agi/training-guide.md) · [AGI Architecture](/agi/architecture.md)
